VID-LIDERAZGO-01.resumen: The segment discusses the critical transition from being responsible for individual tasks to leading and managing people. It highlights the common failure of organizations to train individuals for leadership roles as they advance.

VID-LIDERAZGO-02.resumen: La vulnerabilidad es esencial para la innovación, la creatividad y el cambio. La vergüenza, organizada por género, requiere empatía para superarla y fomentar la conexión.
